chunks: Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

If a woman performs her five daily prayers, fasts her month, performs hajj to the House of her Lord, obeys her husband, and recognizes the right of ʿAlī عليه السلام, then let her enter from whichever gates of the gardens she wishes.

key_terms.أَطَاعَتْ زَوْجَهَا: obeyed her husband in the marital sphere
key_terms.حَقَّ عَلِيٍّ: the right and authority of ʿAlī عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about a woman's worship, obedience to her husband, and entry into Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a set of central religious and marital duties whose fulfillment leads to entry into Paradise. It joins worship, spousal obedience, and recognition of the right of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as qualities of great spiritual consequence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4531 - Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said:

"If a woman performs her five daily prayers, fasts during her month (Ramadan), performs Hajj to the House of her Lord (azj), obeys her husband, and acknowledges the right of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), then she may enter Paradise through whichever gate she wishes."
